definitions.full: H4152. muadah מוּעָדָה noun feminine הַמּ ׳עָרֵי cities appointed (for refuge) Josh 20:9 (P).

occurrences.englishText: These were the appointed cities for all the children of Israel, and for the alien who lives among them, that whoever kills any person unintentionally might flee there, and not die by the hand of the avenger of blood, until he stands trial before the congregation.
